104 Example Willow Loop, Austin: 4 beds, 3 baths, 2,480 sq ft. Stored active price: $749,000. Recorded days on market: 56.

The saved CMA computes $727,321, with an empirical comparable range of $719,400–$738,100, using 7 selected sales. Conservative / moderate / aggressive strategy anchors are $719,400 / $727,321 / $738,100. These are scenario anchors, not predicted sale probabilities.

Assumptions: $110 per square foot difference, $12,000 per bedroom, $15,000 per bathroom, and 0.00% monthly trend. The comparable limit is 3 miles and 180 days.

Reliability checks: Professional review required. This calculation is a pricing aid, not an appraisal or a guaranteed sale price. The range spans adjusted observed comparables; it is not a statistical confidence interval or a forecast coverage guarantee. Adjustment rates and distance/age/size filters are explicit user assumptions, not coefficients learned from this sample. Weights use inverse distance, sale age, and relative size difference. Lot, school boundaries, concessions, permits, title, and unobserved condition are not modeled. Bedroom and square-footage adjustments may double-count related value; inspect sensitivity before use.

Demonstration evidence: the selected property and market examples are fictional. Workspace examples are frozen at 2026-10-15; individual synthetic provider fixtures retain their own dated provenance. No live MLS or public-record lookup was performed by the assistant.
